purpose: Separate the contribution of direct test-pixel access from neighborhood geometry in the accepted random-pixel diagnostic.

masking.mask_source: the exact randomized test mask for the current split
masking.mask_scope: before every inference window is forwarded, every test-mask pixel in that window is replaced by normalized zero (the training-set channel mean)
masking.neighboring_test_pixels: all are masked simultaneously, so the diagnostic removes direct test-pixel values but retains unmasked neighboring training and validation pixels
masking.checkpoint_and_architecture: reuse the exact accepted V1 checkpoints and V1.1 inference settings

comparison.baseline: the corresponding unmasked V1.1 probability and result for the same model, split, and seed
secondary_metrics: precision and recall at top 1 percent
precision and recall at top 5 percent
F1 precision and recall at fixed 0.5
comparison.interpretation: a drop after input masking is evidence that direct pixel access contributed to the random-holdout score; it does not isolate all spatial-context leakage

prohibited_claims: masked inference proves the model learned geology
masked inference is a spatial generalization estimate
the diagnostic discovers concealed or new faults
